title: cart-service 5xx rate 23% during Redis maintenance window
description: GET /cart started returning 500 at 14:20, coinciding with a scheduled Redis failover. Logs show 'cache backend unreachable' immediately followed by a 500 for the same request id. The notable part is that origin database load did NOT rise during the window -- requests are not falling through to the database, they are just failing. Previous Redis failovers this quarter caused a latency bump and no errors at all.
